notes: A research benchmark with unusually good engineering hygiene for academic code: tests, CI, pre-commit, design docs, and readthedocs, all corroborated across four origins. The README is admittedly unfinished ('TODO: fill out :)') and gives an Avalanche usage example but no install instructions, so setup is not reproducible from the README alone. Its two stars underline the fairness rule that stars are never quality — the artifact quality here exceeds its popularity.
